biomarkers.name: C19MC amplification (ETMR)
biomarkers.prevalence: Present in most ETMR; defining when identified, with a minority of ETMR being DICER1-mutant and C19MC-nonaltered

biomarkers.name: DICER1 germline (subset of ETMR)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Identifies DICER1 syndrome in a subset of ETMR

biomarkers.name: Methylation profiling
biomarkers.clinical_use: Essential for classification of embryonal tumours per WHO CNS5

biomarkers.name: BCOR internal tandem duplication
biomarkers.prevalence: Defining for CNS tumour with BCOR internal tandem duplication

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Primitive neuroectodermal cells with variable rosette formation
variants: embryonal tumour with multilayered rosettes (ETMR — C19MC-altered or DICER1-mutant)
CNS tumour with BCOR internal tandem duplication

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Undifferentiated neural stem/progenitor cells with distinct molecular signatures for each subtype
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Embryonal undifferentiated with variable focal neural or other differentiation; specific WHO 2021/2022 entities (ETMR — embryonal tumour with multilayered rosettes, CNS neuroblastoma, FOXR2-activated, CNS tumour with BCOR internal tandem duplication, others) each with characteristic morphology
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Each subtype has distinct molecular signature: ETMR (usually C19MC amplification, with DICER1 alteration in some), CNS neuroblastoma, FOXR2-activated, CNS tumour with BCOR internal tandem duplication, medulloepithelioma
